description: UCI row 3 (age 45, MEDIUM vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 4, horizon 5yr) — sector equity etf: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Karin Johansen is 45 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 47,300 euros (around 3,942 euros per month). They hold 18,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 10,000 euros with a 5-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 4 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 10,000 euros if the investment performs poorly. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund providing concentrated exposure to European technology and digitisation sector companies. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Sector concentration produces higher volatility than diversified equity funds; basic financial knowledge is required. The recommended minimum holding period is five years.
